name: shredder
title: Shredder
description: A vertical list of files sits above a thin shredder slot. Drag a row into the slot, or press Delete, and it is shredded into coloured curls that fall below.
use: A playful app wants deletion to feel deliberate and satisfying instead of a silent bin icon.
avoid: Shredding is pointer-led with a Delete key fallback, and the falling strips need a tall area below the list.
a11y: Focused rows can be shredded with Delete, but drag-to-reorder has no keyboard route and rows show no focus ring. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A stack of dark rounded file rows, each with a small coloured type badge, a truncated filename and a size, ends just above a thin grey horizontal slit. Below the slit coloured paper strips curl and hang down.
behaves: Rows can be dragged down into the slit, where the card is sliced into narrow strips that curl and fall while the list closes the gap. The demo also cycles through shredding each row on its own.
customise: Items, a render function, shred and reorder callbacks plus width, height, feed speed, strip width, curl, loop and colours are props.
weight: moderate: A rAF loop paints curled canvas strips while shredding, then stops when the list is empty.
